title: Implement botspy sessions
description: botspy sessions: unified listing across every source, most recent activity first (SessionStore::list_sessions). Filters --source/--project/--since/--until, --limit. -o json is [SessionSummary] serialized. Spec: features/cli/sessions.feature.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: sessions verb passes all 10 scenarios in features/cli/20_sessions.feature — unified listing over the real adapters via SessionStore::list_sessions, --source (repeatable) / --project / --since / --until / --limit filters, human table (truncated ids, count footer), json/ndjson machine modes, unknown source exit 1. The --project scenario asserts its full id via --no-truncate since human mode truncates ids by design.
